en: The image shows an old black-and-white photograph of a traditional Chinese-style building with ornate, upturned eaves and a walled enclosure. In front of the gate, a few people, including children, can be seen standing or walking. There are some leafless trees and a utility pole nearby. The caption at the bottom of the postcard includes both English and Chinese text, referencing Tainan and Formosa.
